title: Profile
description: How you appear, how ControlHome looks for you, your password and your safety PIN.

preferences.title: Profile and preferences
preferences.description: Saved to your account, so they follow you to every device.
preferences.themeHelp: System follows your device's light or dark setting.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use at least 10 characters. Changing it signs you out on your other devices.

pin.title: Safety PIN
pin.description: 4 to 8 digits that confirm safety actions, such as unlocking a door or opening the gate. Only you know it.
pin.locked: Locked for {minutes} min after wrong PINs
pin.passwordHelp: The password you sign in with. It confirms it's you.
pin.help: 4 to 8 digits. Avoid birthdays and sequences such as 1234.
